I couldn't find any mention of `createAISDKTelemetry` in the results. The import path you gave, `agents/observability/ai`, does appear, but it's paired with a different function, `wrapAISDK()`. You may be thinking of that function, or the name may be from an older or different version of the docs.

Cloudflare's changelog shows the current usage. For direct AI SDK calls, wrap the AI SDK namespace once. wrapAISDK() supports AI SDK v6 and v7. The example imports the AI SDK as a namespace, then calls `wrapAISDK(ai)` from `agents/observability/ai` and uses the returned object's methods, such as `generateText`.

Setup also requires enabling Workers tracing. The changelog shows this in the Wrangler config, with "observability": { "traces": { "enabled": true } }. Think and Flue applications emit agent traces automatically., so the wrapper is only needed for direct AI SDK calls.

Sources also differ on scope. One third-party guide says Cloudflare documents wrapAISDK() for AI SDK and custom spans aligned with OpenTelemetry Generative AI conventions for other harnesses. Another summarizes that the agent view can link a turn to model calls, tool execution, approval events, supported subagents, token metadata, and the Workers resources used underneath.

Because I found only one search's worth of results, I'd check the current wrapAISDK reference on developers.cloudflare.com before relying on it. If you have a snippet that uses `createAISDKTelemetry`, share it and I can search for that specific name or the version it comes from.

content.text:
I couldn't find `createAISDKTelemetry()` in Cloudflare's docs. The function `agents/observability/ai` actually exports is **`wrapAISDK()`**. First, turn on Workers tracing in your Wrangler config with `"observability": { "traces": { "enabled": true } }`. Then wrap the AI SDK once with `import * as ai from "ai"; import { wrapAISDK } from "agents/observability/ai"; const tracedAI = wrapAISDK(ai);` and call `tracedAI.generateText({ model, prompt, telemetry: { functionId: "my-agent" } })` and the other methods on `tracedAI` instead of on `ai`.

Recording messages and tools is off by default; turn it on with `wrapAISDK(ai, { storeMessages: true, storeTools: true })` only if those payloads are safe to store. It works with AI SDK v6 and v7. You only need it for direct AI SDK calls, because Think and Flue apps send agent traces automatically.

If `createAISDKTelemetry` is from a snippet or a specific package version, send it to me and I'll look it up.

Sources:
- [Cloudflare changelog: Agent tracing (2026-08-04)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-08-04-agent-tracing/)
- [Flowith: Cloudflare agent tracing guide](https://flowith.io/blog/cloudflare-agent-tracing-opentelemetry-ai-sdk-guide/)
